prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 上海部分门店地址与营业时间 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "门店" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "地址" · longest unbreakable word 36px · one-line width 412px
  col 3: header "电话" · longest unbreakable word 44px · one-line width 112px
  col 4: header "营业时间" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 88px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者查找上海门店，并确认地址、联系电话和营业时间。","reading":"读者通常先按门店名称定位，再沿同一行查看地址、电话和营业时间；比较门店时也可能纵向浏览营业时间。","groups":["门店与地址共同确定到访地点，名称是行的识别入口，地址是主要的详细信息。","电话与营业时间都是到访前的实用信息，适合并列浏览。"],"keep_intact":["电话号码应保持在同一行，便于识别和拨打。","地址中的楼层、铺位等标识以及营业时间中的时间数字应尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["地址较长，可在自然位置换行；地址换行形成的行高也可容纳同一行中门店名称或营业时间的换行。","门店名称和营业时间可以换行，但应避免拆散难以辨认的标识或时间数字。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [144, 333, 133, 109] · table 720×394px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [130, 347, 133, 109] · table 720×348px · row heights [36, 60, 36, 60, 60, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [150, 327, 133, 109] · table 720×394px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"门店名称、电话和营业时间均保持单行，读者可以迅速定位门店并横向查阅；地址占据主要宽度，六个等高数据行也形成稳定节奏。","problems":"多处地址在楼层或铺位标识附近断行，例如“502”与“铺”、“B1-15”与“室”分开；第二行有时只剩一个字，显得零碎。","cause":"地址列为333px，可用文本宽度约312px，尚不足以容纳这些地址的完整末尾。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"347px的地址列让部分地址保持单行，也改善了一些地址末尾的完整性；电话和营业时间仍清楚地保持单行。","problems":"两个较长门店名的“店”被挤到下一行，削弱了作为行识别入口的名称；部分楼层标识仍跨行，行高变化也使表格节奏较不均匀。","cause":"门店列缩至130px，可用文本宽度约109px，小于最长名称的123px；增加的地址宽度仍不足以让所有长地址完整单行。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"门店名称、电话和营业时间都保持单行，地址的多行排布和统一行高使各行边界清楚。","problems":"门店列比容纳最长名称所需更宽，地址列因而更窄；地址末尾仍有“铺”“室”等孤字，部分楼层标识也被拆开。","cause":"门店列150px比最长名称及内边距所需的144px多6px，使地址列缩至327px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"address-first","widths":[144,343,133,99],"change":"保留门店名称和电话的单行宽度，从营业时间列移出10px给地址，观察能否减少地址末尾孤字；同时检查营业时间换行是否仍能保持时间数字完整。"},{"name":"balanced-address","widths":[144,338,133,104],"change":"从营业时间列移出5px给地址，尝试在改善地址断行与保持营业时间易读之间取得平衡。"},{"name":"near-single-line-names","widths":[140,337,133,109],"change":"从门店列移出4px给地址，测试名称是否仍能自然换行，以及较小的地址增宽是否能改善铺位标识断行。"}]}
